head: 48b7fc950837e1bdcec07abfd181f4d8fa95b6db
environment: Windows 11 10.0.26100; Python 3.14.5; SQLite 3.50.4; Intel i9-14900HX 24C/32T; default timer
notes: All timing fields are ms except absolute perf_counter seconds in transaction boundary timestamps.
wait_ms is BEGIN IMMEDIATE call latency, including SQLite overhead; not pure internal busy wait.
hold_ms is successful BEGIN return to COMMIT return; hold_body_ms ends at COMMIT entry.
prefix_evidence_span_ms excludes earlier source Identity plan-map verification; validation_ms includes it.
SQL SELECT statement counts include persistent and newly opened connections.
Identity sizes include both source Mission and a one-node writer Mission plus schema.
Three fresh independent fixtures per shape; no p95 or worst-case claim.
